model.notes: Not a foundation model. Amino-acid (20) and dipeptide (400) frequencies, the reference every protein model must beat.

ceiling.method: empirical: best of {scaled, unscaled} x {raw, pca50, pca128} x {C=1, C=0.1} logistic regression; configuration chosen on a validation carve of the training set (validation), then refit on the full training set and scored once on test
ceiling.note: Won by scaled/pca50/C=1. Interpret model scores relative to this: at or above it, the representation adds nothing over standard supervised practice on the raw features.

extra.clustering: position-disjoint: mutations at a given residue are confined to one side of the split, so the probe cannot score by learning which positions matter

caveats: Does not beat the composition_centroid baseline (0.550): the representation adds nothing over cheap sequence composition.
Position alone reaches 0.528 macro-F1: much of this task is which residue was hit, not what it was changed to.
Does not survive the position-matched null (p=0.218); treat the score as unsupported.
Exceeds the empirical ceiling (0.545): the representation adds over the best cheap supervised readout of composition features.
No elicitation gap by construction: the best internal layer is the sanctioned surface.
Fine-tuning (F) not measured: adapter does not support it.
